detail.longDescription: Put my first ever product up for sale: a Notion template for people who start too many things. Every new idea goes in an inbox and gets one of six decisions. Max 3 active projects, each with a next physical action. A short checkpoint whenever you stop. Happy to get get recommendations on what changes could be made! https:// aayushjha64.gumroad.com/l/fini sh-os # Notion # Productivity # BuildInPublic
